description: Menge is an open-source crowd simulation framework whose repository ships dozens of example scenarios that can be played in sequence or run one at a time from the command line, with a visualisation window for pausing the run and inspecting individual agents. Scenarios are specified in XML files, for example a four-square crossing scenario, and command-line options set parameters; it builds on Windows, where dependencies are bundled, and on Linux and macOS with the SDL 2 libraries for visualisation. The repository README refers users to the Menge home page on gamma.cs.unc.edu for details. Coverage: generic. Access: free source code. Licence: Apache 2.0. Caveats: the build badge points to a retired Travis CI service, suggesting little recent maintenance, and the home page was not read. Simulation uses: testing crowd behaviour models and navigation methods in public space and venue layouts. Related records: Vadere and PEDSIM.
